raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 was delivered twice (02:00 and 05:00). The 05:00 copy carries txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, which breaks the TIMESTAMP cast. The epoch value 1768543211000 equals 2026-01-16 06:00:11 UTC, the same time as the original row. The 345 extra rows (5320 total vs 4975 distinct txn_id) are exact duplicates of the originals. The fix is to parse both timestamp formats and dedupe by txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH d AS (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1), p AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM d) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM p WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
